tier1.headline: Your data shared commercially
tier1.quote: If you consent (Art. 6,1, a GDPR), we will also share your hashed personal data (e – mail, phone number, interest) with Google, Meta and other social media providers for the Customer Audience Match feature.

tier1.headline: Your data trains AI models
tier1.quote: One.com does not use Google Workspace API data to develop, improve, or train generalized AI/ML models.

tier1.headline: Your financial data collected
tier1.quote: We may collect data necessary to process your payment if you choose to make purchases, such as your payment instrument number, and the security code associated with your payment instrument.

tier2.headline: Your DNT requests ignored
tier2.quote: As such, we do not currently respond to DNT browser signals or any other mechanism that automatically communicates your choice not to be tracked online.

tier2.headline: Your data shared broadly
tier2.quote: We may share your information with our affiliates, in which case we will require those affiliates to honour this Privacy Notice.

tier2.headline: Your data kept for 5 years
tier2.quote: No purpose in this notice will require us keeping your personal information for longer than 5 years past the termination of the user’s account.

tier2.headline: Your precise location collected
tier2.quote: For example, we may use GPS and other technologies to collect geolocation data that tells us your current location (based on your IP address).

tier2.headline: Your data used for ads
tier2.quote: We may process your name, contact details and information collected via cookies (log and usage data, location data, device data) to develop and display personalised content and advertising tailored to your interests, location, and more.

tier2.headline: Your data transfers globally
tier2.quote: If you are accessing our Services from outside Denmark, please be aware that your information may be transferred to, stored by, and processed by us in our facilities and in the facilities of the third parties with whom we may share your personal information (see ‘ When and with whom do we share your personal information? ‘ above), in the United States, India, United Arab Emirates, and other countries.

tier2.headline: Your data disclosed legally
tier2.quote: In some cases we are legally obligated to provide your personal information to authorities, for example if the data is relevant for a criminal investigation.
